name: host
label: Host URL
help: Full URL to your Proxmox VE host including port. Example: https://192.168.1.100:8006

name: tokenId
label: Token ID
help: API token identifier in the format USER@REALM!TOKENID. Example: monitoring@pam!squaredup

name: tokenSecret
label: Token Secret
help: The UUID secret displayed when the API token was created.

name: ignoreCertificateErrors
label: Ignore certificate errors
help: Enable when connecting to a Proxmox VE instance with a self-signed certificate.

name: monitorBackupServer
label: Monitor a Proxmox Backup Server
help: Enable to also monitor a Proxmox Backup Server instance that backs up this cluster — datastores, backup groups, snapshots, and maintenance tasks.

fields.name: pbsHost
fields.label: Backup Server Host URL
fields.help: Full URL to your Proxmox Backup Server instance including port. Example: https://192.168.1.101:8007

fields.name: pbsTokenId
fields.label: Backup Server Token ID
fields.help: API token identifier in the format USER@REALM!TOKENID. Example: monitoring@pbs!squaredup

fields.name: pbsTokenSecret
fields.label: Backup Server Token Secret
fields.help: The UUID secret displayed when the API token was created.
